usage: icebath acp [-h] [--accept-hooks] [--version] [--check] [--setup] [--setup-browser] [--yes]

Start Icebath Agent in ACP mode for editor integration (VS Code, Zed, JetBrains)

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --accept-hooks   Auto-approve unseen shell hooks without a TTY prompt (equivalent to
                   ICEBATH_ACCEPT_HOOKS=1 / hooks_auto_accept: true).
  --version        Print Icebath ACP version and exit
  --check          Verify ACP dependencies and adapter imports, then exit
  --setup          Run interactive Icebath provider/model setup for ACP terminal auth
  --setup-browser  Install PM's pinned Chromium for browser_exec (idempotent).
  --yes, -y        Accept all prompts (used by --setup-browser to skip the ~400 MB Chromium
                   download confirmation).
